data.name: Creatine HCL
data.description:
Better absorption and solubility and greater increase in physical performance.

Our body is capable of metabolizing creatine naturally, but it does so in very limited concentrations and part of it is broken down and excreted daily. For this reason, the daily creatine requirements are sometimes not covered, especially when performing intense physical activity, which is why its contribution as external supplementation is highly recommended.
     

Through numerous studies it has been proven that creatine supplementation improves energy performance levels, in addition to favoring recovery from fatigue and physical stress. All this is due to the function it performs in our body by synthesizing as free muscle creatine and phosphocreatine, the latter being the precursor of adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the most powerful energy molecule produced at the cellular level.

StarLabs Nutrition Creatine HCL is a form of creatine bound to hydrochloric acid, resulting in creatine hydrochloride or creatine HCL.

According to various studies, it has been shown that Creatine HCL is up to 38 times more soluble than creatine monohydrate, thus improving its absorption and giving greater stability to the creatine molecule.

All this means that we can obtain the same beneficial effects of creatine monohydrate by consuming less amount of Creatine HCL.
